items.period: Shang period (script-style label; individual artifact date not established on the file page)
items.caption: 工 in a form labeled Shang oracle-bone script. Early forms are interpreted as tool-like, though the proposed object remains disputed.
items.alt: Black rendering of 工 with a broad, sloping top stroke, a long central vertical, and a lower stroke that extends to the right.
items.selection_reason: This labeled early form illustrates the graph relevant to the pictographic interpretation; its shape alone does not identify the object depicted.
items.rights: CC0 1.0/public domain per Commons description; attribution appreciated but not required. Sinica query-interface glyph image is covered by its CC0 notice.

items.period: Shuowen seal-script tradition (Han dictionary form; this is a modern rendering)
items.caption: 工 in Shuowen small seal-script style, a labeled historical form of the character.
items.alt: Black rendering of 工 with a long, nearly horizontal top stroke, a central vertical, and a long lower stroke.
items.selection_reason: Provides a clearly identified seal-script form for comparison with the oracle-script example, without implying a sequence of graphic changes.
items.rights: CC0 1.0/public domain per Commons description; attribution appreciated but not required. Sinica query-interface glyph image is covered by its CC0 notice.

limitations.text: The early graph’s proposed referent remains uncertain: interpretations include a bladed tool, a square, and a building tool. These renderings show labeled script forms, not artifact photographs, and do not resolve that disagreement.
